TLDR: read the default gas limit form config.yaml (new optional array field, kinda like bpo schedule) also <@&1460290804898861117> ^ Hey @glamsterdam-cl I’d like to re- if the global circuit breaker is triggered, and local payload fails for some reason, do we still wanna fallback to bids, or do we rather miss the payload in that case? was thinking of Toni's attack for example and in this case, it might be safer to not use builder bids at all

excerpts.author: barnabasbusa
excerpts.content:
Hey <@&1417820113981145228> I’d like to re-propose [eip-8261](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8261) for glamsterdam. I have made a tons of modifications to the original idea, (where gas limit steps would be consensus breaking) and now the EIP is just an informational one.
TLDR: read the default gas limit form config.yaml (new optional array field, kinda like bpo schedule)

excerpts.author: nflaig
excerpts.content: if the global circuit breaker is triggered, and local payload fails for some reason, do we still wanna fallback to bids, or do we rather miss the payload in that case? was thinking of Toni's attack for example and in this case, it might be safer to not use builder bids at all
